name: Contribution-based Pruning
aliases: Contribution-based Pruning — Opacity and Scale Pruning, Quantile-based Pruning
definition: A pruning strategy to remove redundant Gaussians based on their opacity and scale attributes, where low opacity and scale indicate insignificant contribution.
summary: Contribution-based Pruning removes redundant 3D Gaussians by jointly evaluating opacity and scale, avoiding the performance degradation caused by using either attribute alone.
